Perception Music 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Transforms agent perception data (brightness, RMS, phase, temperature, presence) into music using a custom FM synthesizer written in Zig.
- No dependencies, API calls, or ML models — 141KB statically linked binary.
- Outputs WAV or MP3 files mapped directly from real-world sensor data.
- Includes Python scripts for automatic data detection and music composition.
- Sample compositions and detailed documentation provided.
